top_story.headline: Rep. Pete Sessions Reports 32 Stock Sales in One Filing, With Three Positions at $250,001 to $500,000
top_story.dek: Most of the sales are dated October 2 and carry a spouse ownership code.
paragraphs: Rep. Pete Sessions (R-TX17) filed a periodic transaction report on October 27 listing 32 transactions. Every one is a sale. The largest are Apple Inc., Costco Wholesale Corporation and Microsoft Corporation, each in the $250,001 to $500,000 range and each coded as spouse-owned and dated October 2. Read the filing.

Seventeen sales are dated October 2 and carry a spouse code, and one more spouse-owned sale (McDonald's Corporation) is dated October 27. The other 14 carry no owner code and are dated October 8 through October 28. The report lists an October 28 sale of Walt Disney Company shares even though its filing date is October 27. None of the trades is flagged as past the 45-day deadline.

The most clear-cut disclosure violation in today's batch is a different filing. Rep. Jodey Arrington (R-TX19) reported a July 10, 2025 sale that was disclosed 474 days after the trade, against a 45-day limit. Read the filing.

sections.eyebrow: Contacts With the President, VP & Cabinet
sections.headline: No logged contacts with the President or cabinet; one lobbying report names the Vice President
paragraphs: No FARA filings in this window were handed over for review. One LDA filing lists the Vice President as an entity lobbied.

items: Motor & Equipment Manufacturers Association (in-house, lobbying for itself) filed a third-quarter amendment that lists the Vice President among the entities lobbied. The filing describes lobbying on preventing imports of counterfeit automotive parts, motor vehicle manufacturing and vehicle technology, and consumer access to vehicle data and choice of repairer. LDA filing.

sections.headline: No notable ethics filings in the past three days
paragraphs: The Office of Government Ethics processed nine filings during the October 25–28 window, with no divestitures, terminations, or other actions requiring public attention.

sections.headline: Seven House filings: one 474-day late disclosure and one 32-sale report
paragraphs: Seven House filings were new this window: five periodic transaction reports and two candidate reports. The Senate eFD check failed on this run, so no Senate filings are included and none can be ruled out. Trade tables for the five PTRs are appended below.

items: Rep. Jodey Arrington (R-TX19), filed October 27: one jointly owned sale, of Montego, dated July 10, 2025, in the $15,001 to $50,000 range. This is a late disclosure: it came 474 days after the trade. Filing.
Rep. Sheri Biggs (R-SC03), filed October 27: one purchase, of Oaktree Strategic Credit Fund Class S, dated September 30, 2026, spouse-owned, $1,001 to $15,000. Filing.

Rep. Suzan K. DelBene (D-WA01), filed October 28: two jointly owned municipal bond trades dated October 14, 2026, each in the $250,001 to $500,000 range. One is a purchase of Black Belt Energy Gas District (Alabama) project revenue bonds due 12/01/2035. The other is a sale of Tennessee Energy Acquisition bonds due 12/01/35. Filing.
Dr. Kelly Esti (candidate, GA08), candidate report filed October 27. Filing.
Steven Feldman (candidate, NC10), candidate report filed October 28. Filing.

Rep. Max Miller (R-OH07), filed October 27: two partial sales of private fund interests, each $1,001 to $15,000. They are AIX Ventures Fund II, LP (October 1) and Mercato Partners Traverse IV QP, LP (September 30), both listed through GLAS Funds, LP. Filing.

Rep. Pete Sessions (R-TX17), filed October 27: 32 transactions, all sales. Apple, Costco (October 2) and Microsoft are each $250,001 to $500,000 and spouse-owned. Alphabet Class C and Amazon (October 2, spouse) are $100,001 to $250,000, as is a separate Costco sale on October 13. Walmart Inc. and Abbott Laboratories sales are $50,001 to $100,000 and spouse-owned. The rest are $1,001 to $50,000, plus a $344 sale of Resideo Technologies, Inc. Companies include Tesla, NVIDIA, Visa, Mastercard, Chevron, ExxonMobil and Berkshire Hathaway. Eighteen trades are spouse-coded and 14 carry no owner code. A Disney sale is dated October 28, a day after the filing date. No trade is flagged late. Filing.
